why: The negative control for the smoothing: an easing curve that leaves [0, 1] sends the interpolated offset outside the interval spanned by the two bucket draws, so the aim error exceeds the +/-spread envelope its profile's aimAccuracy is tuned for -- a silent difficulty change wearing a smoothing fix's clothes. Killed by the no-overshoot case, which without this mutation is the one assertion in that block the stepping implementation also satisfied.
killedBy: aimJitter drift across a bucket (issue #222) never moves the aim offset by half a spread in one tick, across two whole buckets
aimJitter drift across a bucket (issue #222) travels between the two adjacent bucket draws without overshooting either
aimJitter drifts within a bucket, arriving near the next bucket's draw by its last tick
